lines.t: Surely the Lord God doesn’t do anything without revealing His plans to His servants…
(His prophets)
From the volumes of truth, a trumpet call,
A warning to the world, yet love for all.
Grace and law in one embrace,
The Lord reveals His holy face.
No profit, no gain, just a voice that cries,
“Return to the Garden, open your eyes.”
Feel it rising, feel it shake the ground,
Every chain, every lie comes down.
The Lord is speaking, can’t you hear the sound?
His vibrating love is breaking through the noise.
Vibrating truth in every line,
Words of life, by design.
From the volumes, the Lord’s decree,
Vibrating love, vibrating light,
Setting all the captives right.
Hear the Lord, His voice rings true,
This generation, He’s speaking to you.
From the volumes, a fire in the bone,
A trumpet to the nations, yet mercy on the throne.
Tear the veil from your eyes, let every idol fall—
The Lord is near; He’s calling, and He’s calling now to all.
Feel it rising, feel it shake the ground,
Every veil, every shadow comes down.
The Lord is speaking, can’t you hear the sound?
His vibrating truth is breaking through the noise.
Vibrating truth in every line,
Words of life, by design.
From the volumes, the Lord’s decree,
Vibrating love, vibrating light,
Setting all the captives right.
Hear the Lord, His voice rings true,
This generation, He’s speaking to you.
A non-profit grace, a love that’s pure.
For all who have ears, hear the call.
Vibrating truth in every line,
Words of life, by design.
From the volumes, the Lord’s decree,
Vibrating love, vibrating light,
Setting all the captives right.
Hear the Lord, His voice rings true,
This generation, He’s speaking to you.
